messages:
nina: hey team, first-day hiccup. i accepted the org invite but when i try to clone redwood/console i get a 403. on the org page my user shows as "Outside collaborator" and no teams. github handle is ninacodes, email nina@redwood.ai

devex: welcome @nina! quick q: did you accept with your work account or a personal one that has your work email attached?

nina: i used an existing personal account (ninacodes) and added my work email to it, but it's not primary. thought that would be fine.

sree-perms: That often causes SSO/permission oddness. Do you see a banner about "Authorize SAML SSO" when viewing the org?

nina: yeah it shows "You must authorize SSO to access organization resources" with a button. i clicked it and it sent me to the company login but then just returned to GH with the same banner.

it-ops: Two things to try: (1) make your work email primary/verified on the GH account, (2) enable 2FA if not already. Also try the authorize flow in an incognito window to avoid cookie issues.

nina: enabled 2FA and made work email primary, tried authorize in incognito — still stuck on the banner.

github-bot: SAML SSO authorization attempted for ninacodes by nina.

sree-perms: I can resend a direct org membership invite to the exact GH username so it's created as a Member instead of an outside collaborator. Resending now.

github-bot: Organization invitation sent to ninacodes (nina@redwood.ai) by sree-perms.

nina: accepted the new invite (bell icon) and the banner cleared. cloning still 403 though.

it-ops: Do you use HTTPS remote? Sometimes a cached personal PAT/credential helper causes 403 even after membership fixes. Run `git remote -v` and check. If HTTPS, either clear the credential helper or switch to SSH. Example: `git remote set-url origin git@github.com:redwood/console.git` then ensure your SSH key is added to your GH account.

nina: oof, i had an old personal PAT stored in credential helper. removed it and switched to SSH. added my SSH pubkey to GitHub. clone works now :tada:

sree-perms: Perfect. I also added you to the "eng-console" team. If you see any repo-level 403s ping me and include the `git remote -v` output and `whoami` on GH.

devex: adding a short note to the onboarding checklist: prefer accepting invites with work account or verify/make work email primary, enable 2FA, and check for cached personal PATs; include SSH setup snippet. thanks for the quick debug everyone 44d

nina: thanks y'all 60a super smooth onboarding so far!
